name: kprobe_clear
author: jm33-ng
comment: List and clear kprobe/uprobe events and ftrace state through tracefs, removing the kernel-side hooks an EDR installs

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: list, clear-kprobes, clear-uprobes, or tracing-off

parameters.name: tracefs
parameters.description: Tracefs root override (empty = auto-detect /sys/kernel/tracing then /sys/kernel/debug/tracing)

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Report what clear-kprobes/clear-uprobes would remove without writing

name: linux_sysctl_blind
author: jm33-ng
comment: Show or set security-relevant kernel sysctls (blind/open/set) to restrict the information sources EDRs rely on

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: show, blind (restrict), open (restore permissive), or set (use --name/--value)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Sysctl key for set, e.g. kernel.kptr_restrict or a full /proc/sys path

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to write when action=set

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Report blind/open changes without writing them

name: dmesg_wipe
author: jm33-ng
comment: Read, grep, or clear the kernel ring buffer via the syslog(2) syscall

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: show, grep (use --pattern), or wipe

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Substring to match when action=grep

name: linux_log_wipe
author: jm33-ng
comment: Truncate or pattern-scrub text logs, shell history and lastlog without spawning shred/rm

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: wipe (one file or the standard log set), hist (shell history), or lastlog

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Specific file to wipe (empty = the standard text log list)

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Remove only lines containing this substring (empty = truncate the whole file)

parameters.name: home
parameters.description: Home directory whose shell history to truncate when action=hist (empty = $HOME)

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Report what would be removed without writing

name: linux_coredump_block
author: jm33-ng
comment: Suppress core dumps and memory-scanner access via prctl/prlimit64/coredump_filter (self, pid, madv or system-wide)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: show, self, pid, madv, or system

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Target PID when action=pid

name: linux_vma_hide
author: jm33-ng
comment: Mark an anonymous mapping MADV_DONTDUMP or give it a non-revealing VMA name

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: dontdump (exclude an anonymous mapping from core dumps) or name (set a benign VMA name)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: VMA name to apply when action=name (e.g. [heap])

name: linux_self_delete
author: jm33-ng
comment: Unlink a running binary (default /proc/self/exe) so it disappears from disk while the process keeps running

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File to unlink (empty = /proc/self/exe, the agent's own image)

name: linux_mount_over
author: jm33-ng
comment: Bind-mount, tmpfs-mount, remount read-only, hide a file, or unmount paths; list current mounts

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: list, bind, tmpfs, ro, umount, or hide

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source path for bind, or the file to shadow for hide

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Mount target (or prefix filter for list)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: tmpfs size option, e.g. 10m

name: linux_proc_hide
author: jm33-ng
comment: Hide a PID from /proc with a bind-mounted empty directory, find PIDs by comm name, or list/restore hidden PIDs

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: hide, unhide, name (all PIDs matching a comm substring), or list

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Target PID for hide/unhide

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: comm substring to match when action=name

name: tetragon_blind
author: jm33-ng
comment: Scan for Tetragon/Falco/Cilium eBPF security processes, then freeze, thaw or kill one by PID

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: scan, freeze, thaw, or kill

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Target PID for freeze/thaw/kill

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Process-name substring to search for during scan

name: lkm_unload
author: jm33-ng
comment: List, hunt and unload kernel modules through delete_module(2), removing the LSM/kprobe hooks they carry

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: list, hunt (known EDR modules), info, or unload

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Module name for info/unload

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Pass O_TRUNC to delete_module (force unload; may panic if hooks are active)

name: linux_mmap_read
author: jm33-ng
comment: Read a file through mmap(2), so no read(2) syscall is issued and file-read kprobes never fire

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File to read

parameters.name: cap
parameters.description: Maximum bytes to map and return
